name: buffalo-atomic-application-configuration-batches
instr:
Buffalo cannot atomically publish related HTTP and background-job configuration as one coherent generation. Stage it through `Configuration`, return a `ConfigurationReport` from `App.Configure`, and keep direct configuration compatible.

Publish staged routes, middleware, error policy, and job handlers together in one nonzero generation, or leave all registries and the current generation unchanged. Return callback errors, panics, invalid registrations, and worker preparation failures without exposing staged state. Of concurrent batches based on one generation, one wins and the others return `ErrConfigurationConflict`; later batches may build on the winner.

When `Configuration.RegisterJob` is used, require `Options.Worker` to implement `TransactionalWorker`. Otherwise return `ErrTransactionalWorkerUnsupported` and publish none of the staged application configuration. Batches without jobs must still work with that Worker. Requests and jobs retain their starting generation, including route context and status-specific or default error handling.

Preserve route registration order across Gorilla matching, `App.Routes`, route helpers, mux selection, and `RouteList`. Groups and virtual hosts inherit only committed policy staged before creation. Preserve middleware wrapping, replacement, removal, and per-handler skip semantics. A virtual-host route and status handler published together use matching host policy.

`Simple` must validate the complete candidate handler set before publica
